_method: Three-way NON-MUTATING comparison: Beast working tree (read-only SSH probe via scripts/probe_beast_projection_source.sh) vs GitHub canonical (gh api, read-only) vs /opt/OS mirror (data/repos/*). No Beast writes, no code copied.

_classification_vocab.source_current: Beast clean AND Beast head == GitHub head for the tracked branch (fully reconciled)
_classification_vocab.source_dirty: Beast has uncommitted changes (dirty_count > 0) not on GitHub or mirror
_classification_vocab.source_unpushed: Beast has committed changes ahead of GitHub (ahead > 0 / head absent from GitHub)
_classification_vocab.source_stale: Beast is BEHIND GitHub (GitHub has commits the Beast lacks)
_classification_vocab.branch_diverged: Beast tracks a non-default branch (source is current on that branch but not GitHub default main)
_classification_vocab.mirror_full: data/repos mirror has client + server + schema + build
_classification_vocab.mirror_schema_only: data/repos mirror has schema/config but NO client/server (not the app body)
